mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal impairment; clarithromycin may inhibit metabolism of amphotericin B metabolites, and amphotericin B-induced electrolyte abnormalities may potentiate clarithromycin toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and potassium/magnesium levels closely; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; ensure adequate hydration and dose adjustments based on renal function.
